name: Juven Sakan
source: Viscount Juven Sakan is the head of the Sakan family. Besides being adept in the games of politics, he also authored the book "Finsel's Beauty", which tells about the flower shop girl, the Merc Corps, and even the stories that happened deep within the walls of the church nunnery... Somehow, he knows about all of these.
